From: Oliver Barnes <oliver@cloudscale.ai>

Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up from today's discovery — volumes and pricing targets

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo and for walking us through Redwood's routing and caching approach. Quick recap from our side and a few clarifying questions so we can move to procurement: 

- Expected baseline usage: 4M tokens/month today (mostly summarization and chat).
- Planned step-up: hit ~12–15M tokens/month within 4–6 months as we roll out two new routes (summarize-v2 and search-embed).
- Important: we need a blended unit target to use in our budget review — our procurement lead asked for a target metric in $ / 1M tokens to score the vendor. Internal target budget is around $900–1,000 / 1M tokens but we can consider a higher baseline if step-up discounts apply.
- Also need to understand how adding routes (models) affects blended rate vs. separate per-model pricing.

Can you send a short blended quote with volume bands and a recommended step-up schedule? If you can include a churn/backfill clause and a sample SOW timeline that helps procurement.

We may also share a procurement template (I'll attach if helpful).

Cheers,
Oliver
Head of Platform
CloudScale

Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's discovery — volumes and pricing targets

Oliver —

Great to speak earlier. Below is a concise recap + proposal for next steps so procurement has what it needs.

Recap from Redwood:
- Current: ~4M tokens/mo, expanding to ~12–15M/mo in 4–6 months with summarize-v2 and search-embed routes.
- Efficiency levers we covered: prefix/KV caching on summarize, batched embed generation for search-embed, and recommended 2-variant routing to keep latency SLOs while lowering cost.

Preliminary blended pricing (for budgeting only):
- Band A (0–5M/mo): $1,250 / 1M tokens
- Band B (5–15M/mo): $950 / 1M tokens
- Band C (>15M/mo): $800 / 1M tokens
- Blended example at 12M/mo (mix): ~ $980 / 1M tokens

Notes & assumptions:
- Blended rates assume traffic across routes uses similar token distributions; if search-embed is heavy on short embeddings we can offer per-route adjustments.
- We factor in KV caching; effective billable tokens typically drop 10–25% after optimizations.
- Step-up discounts apply on committed bands (monthly commit or 12-month reserved).

Next steps I propose:
1) I'll attach a short blended quote (PDF) and a 6-month usage projection spreadsheet for your budget review.
2) If procurement is happy with the bands above, schedule a 30-min pricing sync so we can confirm committed bands and contract term.
3) We can include route-specific addenda if you want separate pricing for summarize-v2 vs. search-embed.

I attached: redwood-blend-quote-v1.pdf and usage-projection-6mo.xlsx.

If the procurement team wants the target brought to ~$900 / 1M, we can look at a 12-month reserved commit and an early step-up credit for the first two months. Happy to model a couple scenarios.

Best,
Ben Carter

Appreciate the clarity. I've updated the quote to show two scenarios and attached the PDF:

1) 12-month reserved commit (recommended) — modeled blended: $915 / 1M tokens (assumes 10% caching benefit + 15% commit discount + 2-month onboarding credit)
2) Monthly commit with step-up credits — modeled blended: $980 / 1M tokens (no long-term discount; step-up credit for months 1–2)

Key callouts:
- If CloudScale can commit to a 12-month reserved band at 10M tokens/mo minimum, we can meet the ~ $900 target after credits.
- Adding routes is additive to the bands; we can include route-level addenda in the SOW so that new routes inherit the customer’s blended band rather than get separate higher list pricing.
- SLA: included a draft SLO table and automatic fallback policy for model variant removals.

Next steps:
- I attached redwood-blend-quote-v1-revised.pdf with the two scenarios and a short SOW outline.
- If that looks good, let's schedule a 30-min pricing + procurement sync on Monday 24 May at 2:00 PM PT.
